title: Kuze Shiina Origin
overview: A young girl living in peace as a hunter sees her life forever changed when a new threat comes for her sister.

title: UN Investigation Agency EXCEEDS / Diaboli Slayers
overview: Nanoha & Fate recruit Shiina to EXCEEDS, and explain the Diaboli. / A mysterious group of girls slay Diaboli.

title: Kuze Shiina & Yorumi Towa
overview: On her day off from EXCEEDS, Shiina encounters Towa attempting to rescue a cat & the two become fast friends.

title: Yorumi Towa Origin
overview: Shiina is killing progenitors while Towa prepares to make her move, reflecting on the reason for her actions.

title: Chance Encounter
overview: EXCEEDS & the Diaboli Slayers run into each other as both target the facility abusing Progenitor Three & Four.

title: Kuragi Eiji and Shinomiya Mana / Sunlight
overview: Eiji and Mana discuss the Diaboli Slayers and take countermeasures. Shiina and Towa enjoy a day together.

title: Jurisdiction #4's Subway: Running Extermination Battle
overview: Parasitic invaders are unleashed on a public park. As both groups work to stop it Towa becomes a wanted woman.

title: Yorumi Towa Descent
overview: Shiina fails to persuade Towa, and Towa turns herself in to get closer to Shinomiya.

title: EXCEEDS
overview: EXCEEDS interviews the Diaboli Slayers and mobilizes its forces while Towa fights Shinomiya Mana.

title: South Pole Underground Research Lab: Search and Destroy Mission
overview: EXCEEDS raids Shinomiya's lab in the south pole to rescue Towa and exterminate Progenitor Zero.
